name: Jishpa
title: Benjaminite Head
summary: Jishpa was a son of Jibsam and belonged to the tribe of Benjamin. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the heads of the Benjaminite families living in Jerusalem. He is part of the genealogical lists that document the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

siblings: Shephatjah, ancestor of Meshullam from the tribe of Benjamin

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ishpah is mentioned as a son of Jibsam in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, among the family heads who lived in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Part of Benjamin's Tribal Leaders
keyEvents.description: Ishpah was among the Benjaminite family heads recorded in the genealogies of Chronicles, highlighting his position as a leader within the tribe.

keyEvents.title: Residing in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: As one of Benjamin's tribal leaders, Ishpah was among those connected to Jerusalem, since the territory of the tribe of Benjamin bordered the city.

keyEvents.title: Recorded Among Family Heads
keyEvents.description: Ishpah was counted among the heads of his clans, indicating that he held a leading role in his local community.
